quote_state_snapshot_check.name: quote_state_snapshot_check
quote_state_snapshot_check.value: ("quote"."state" = 'DRAFT' and "quote"."issued_snapshot" is null and "quote"."issued_at" is null) or ("quote"."state" in ('AWAITING_CUSTOMER', 'CONFIRMED') and "quote"."issued_snapshot" is not null and "quote"."issued_at" is not null and "quote"."valid_until" is not null and "quote"."total_amount" is not null)

quote_line_exact_amount_check.name: quote_line_exact_amount_check
quote_line_exact_amount_check.value: ("quote_line"."unit_price" is null and "quote_line"."line_amount" is null) or ("quote_line"."unit_price" is not null and "quote_line"."line_amount" is not null and "quote_line"."unit_price" > 0 and "quote_line"."line_amount" = "quote_line"."quantity" * "quote_line"."unit_price")

user_session_auth_pair_check.name: user_session_auth_pair_check
user_session_auth_pair_check.value: ("user_session"."user_id" is null and "user_session"."auth_version" is null) or ("user_session"."user_id" is not null and "user_session"."auth_version" is not null and "user_session"."auth_version" > 0)
